name: YuXin Little Magic 3x3 V3 (MagLev + UV)
description: This isn’t the classic you remember—it’s a next-level powerhouse. Equipped with a MagLev tension system, UV-coated surface, and 6 center travel adjustments, this cube is all about precision and performance. The corner-cutting is impressive straight out of the box, and its smooth turns make solving a dream.
